Data.subject: Labour, Employment, Wages and Productivity
Data.title: Unemployment Rate (End Of Period), Quarterly
Data.footnote: Total population comprises residents and non residents.  Residents refer to Singapore citizens and permanent residents.  Data for June 1995, 2000 and 2005 were obtained from the General Household Survey (June 1995 and 2005) and Population Census (June 2000) conducted by the Singapore Department of Statistics, Ministry of Trade and Industry.  The Labour Force Survey was not conducted in these periods.

row.footnote: Data is non-seasonally adjusted.  Residents refer to Singapore citizens and Singapore Permanent Residents.
